intent.proves: At least one product of type BOM (ProductType 2) has two or more BOM lines.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductId) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductType = 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProductItems i WHERE i.ProductItemProductId = p.ProductId) >= 2
